{{Quote|Look at just the conviction numbers we're allowed to see in the places we know are peaceful. An 18% rise in Kaifo, Tepasi, 21. A 38% increase in Ghorman.|Mon Mothma discussing the Public Order Resentencing Directive with a Cingulon senator|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />}}
'''Kaifo''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> in the [[Kaifo system]] of the [[Colonies]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Despite the location being considered peaceful it saw an eighteen percent increase in conviction numbers<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />  from [[5 BBY]]<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> to [[3 BBY]] as a result of the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]]. In 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] tried to use the conviction numbers to presuade a [[Unidentified Cingulon senator|fellow senator]] to vote with her in challenging a recent extension to the P.O.R.D.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Kaifo was first mentioned in "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," the fourth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
